e.title: Claw-Insurance
e.summary: 保险 agent 助手（龙虾生态）：用结构化产品知识草拟微信/WhatsApp 回复
e.body: Claw-Insurance 是保险 agent 的 AI 助手：基于结构化产品知识，为保险代理草拟微信/WhatsApp 客户回复。对本站：OpenClaw「龙虾」生态里的保险场景应用——与 [[openclaw]]（生态）、[[finclaw]]（金融龙虾）、[[insurance-skills]]（保险技能平台）组成「龙虾 + 保险」家族；培训课展示「给 agent 装保险技能」的落地例。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库描述确认（产品知识→回复草拟），未实测
e.summary_en: Insurance agent assistant (lobster ecosystem): draft WeChat/WhatsApp replies from structured product knowledge
e.summary_hk: 保險 agent 助手（龍蝦生態）：用結構化產品知識草擬微信/WhatsApp 回復
e.body_en: Claw-Insurance is an AI assistant for insurance agents: drafting WeChat/WhatsApp customer replies from structured product knowledge. For this site: an insurance-scenario application in the OpenClaw lobster ecosystem — with [[openclaw]] (the ecosystem), [[finclaw]] (finance lobster) and [[insurance-skills]] (insurance skill platform) it forms the lobster-plus-insurance family; training sessions can show a concrete example of installing insurance skills into an agent.
e.body_hk: Claw-Insurance 是保險 agent 的 AI 助手：基於結構化產品知識，為保險代理草擬微信/WhatsApp 客户回復。對本站：OpenClaw「龍蝦」生態裏的保險場景應用——與 [[openclaw]]（生態）、[[finclaw]]（金融龍蝦）、[[insurance-skills]]（保險技能平台）組成「龍蝦 + 保險」家族；培訓課展示「給 agent 裝保險技能」的落地例。
